2 تَعْسِيفٌ The journeying without any sign of the way and without track; (TA;) and so ↓ تَعَسُّفٌ . (TA in art. سمت: see a verse cited in the first paragraph of that art.) [See also 1, and 4.] ＝
-A2- عسّفهُ, inf. n. as above, He fatigued, or jaded, him, (O, K, TA,) namely, his camel, (O, TA,) by journeying. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
